<?php
// Inventory tracking for a small shop.
class Inventory {
    public array $stockMap = [];

    public function addItem(string $itemName, int $quantity): void {
        // increase the stock for this item
        $current = $this->stockMap[$itemName] ?? 0;
        $this->stockMap[$itemName] = $current + $quantity;
    }

    public function removeItem(string $itemName, int $quantity): bool {
        $current = $this->stockMap[$itemName] ?? 0;
        if ($quantity > $current) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->stockMap[$itemName] = $current - $quantity;
        return true;
    }
}

function totalStock(Inventory $store): int {
    $total = 0;
    foreach ($store->stockMap as $key => $count) {
        if ($count > 0) {
            $total = $total + $count;
        }
    }
    return $total;
}

function lowStock(Inventory $store, int $limit): array {
    $isLow = function (int $level) use ($limit): bool {
        return $level < $limit;
    };
    $result = [];
    foreach ($store->stockMap as $product => $amount) {
        if ($isLow($amount)) {
            $result[] = $product;
        }
    }
    return $result;
}

# Inventory tracking for a small shop.
class Inventory
  attr_reader :stock_map

  def initialize
    @stock_map = Hash.new(0)
  end

  def add_item(item_name, quantity)
    # increase the stock for this item
    current = @stock_map[item_name]
    @stock_map[item_name] = current + quantity
  end

  def remove_item(item_name, quantity)
    current = @stock_map[item_name]
    return false if quantity > current
    @stock_map[item_name] = current - quantity
    true
  end
end

def total_stock(store)
  total = 0
  store.stock_map.each do |key, count|
    if count > 0
      total = total + count
    end
  end
  total
end

def low_stock(store, limit)
  is_low = ->(level) { level < limit }
  result = []
  store.stock_map.each do |product, amount|
    result << product if is_low.call(amount)
  end
  result
end
